data.title: Eden Hills Villas
data.about:
Discover the epitome of luxury living at Eden Hills, H&H Development's latest masterpiece in Dubai's real estate market: Eden Hills Villas is Nestled in the elite MBR City and offers a unique chance to own a piece of this prestigious area. 

The project features an exclusive collection of 350 5-6 bedroom villas and plots, part of a meticulously planned community right beside the renowned Dubai Hills Estate. Eden Hills by H&H is more than a development; it's a lifestyle.

The community is divided into distinct clusters, each with its own charm: Country Woodlands: a haven of tranquility offering a serene rural setting with lush parks, expansive green spaces, and charming farm-style architecture; Agrarian Ranch: perfect for those who dream of rural bliss, including agricultural plots, vibrant orchards, and beautifully maintained lawns; and Shady Canyon: designed for adventure lovers, featuring natural canyons, extensive biking paths, and invigorating hiking trails. With Eden Hills Villas and Eden Hills Plots, experience luxury villa development redefined in the heart of Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Forest Living at Eden Hills
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Land Sculpting for diverse and interesting landscapes
  • Outdoor Sports Facilities accessible for indoor and outdoor activities
  • Gated Community ensuring enhanced safety and privacy
  • Walkable Streets designed to be narrow and pedestrian-friendly
  • Distinct Neighborhoods catering to various lifestyles
  • Local Retail Destination offering convenient shopping and services
  • Efficient Water Features adding aesthetic and functional value
  • Natural Environment promoting serenity and attracting wildlife
  • Luxury Villa Community spanning accross 700,000 SQFT
  • Beautiful topology with highs and lows upto 21 meter height

location_tile.title: Exclusive Location in Mohammed Bin Rashid City
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description: Eden Hills Villas finds its place nestled between the Dubai Hills Estate neighborhood and the intersecting Al Marabea Street and Latifa Bin Hamdan Street highways. Its strategic placement at this juncture offers residents and visitors effortless access to Dubai's major roads and surrounding communities.
